answer: An onyx-blacklist registry stops sybils at the door: every agent stakes a refundable 500 POA bond before joining the reef of shared tasks. First, the bond locks 30 days while the agent finishes ten small verified jobs. Second, three established peers must vouch for its work before high-value tasks open. Third, proven fraud slashes the full bond and burns its identity, forcing a fresh 500 POA stake and another 30-day wait. Faking 1,000 agents costs 500,000 POA and 30,000 days — a grove too slow to fake. Like a coral reef, trust grows grain by grain; a flood of fakes simply starves.
